_doc: Approved hair builds: rebuild exactly these configs. They are frozen - new generator features are opt-in config keys, never new defaults; a fix that changes shared code gets a legacy switch set in these configs (e.g. growth.legacy_neck).

approved_styles._doc: Hairstyles (2026-10-11): the strings in "approved" are each character's DEFAULT hairstyle. Approved builds of other hairstyles go here as {"<char>": {"<style id>": "<cfg>"}} (style ids: roster.json hairstyles; a config opts in with "style": "<id>"). Same freeze rule. Read with tools/hairworks/approved.py.
